mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_change_operation_log (notice_id, notify_id, workshop_code, operation_type, operation_time, operator, operation_result, creator, error_msg, request_params, response_params, remark) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{notifyId}, #{workshopCode}, #{operationType}, #{operationTime}, #{operator}, #{operationResult}, #{creator}, #{errorMsg}, CAST(#{requestParams,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler} AS JSONB), CAST(#{responseParams,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler} AS JSONB), #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, notify_id, workshop_code, operation_type, operation_time, operator, operation_result, error_msg FROM recipe_change_operation_log WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY operation_time DESC , id DESC
